prompts.idle:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game animation sprite sheet for the native macOS PetScape app. The two attached PNGs are CHARACTER IDENTITY / SIZE REFERENCES only; create new poses, do not modify those original files.
Create the IDLE breathing and blink animation of this exact blue-grey kitten: fluffy blue-grey fur, pale cream chest/muzzle/paws, huge amber eyes, pink nose and ears, same large head, compact body, curled upright tail at the LEFT, face turned toward the RIGHT, same cartoon 2.5D rendered style, soft upper-left lighting. Preserve this specific cat, including facial proportions and fur texture.
OUTPUT: a 1536x1024 PNG with real transparent alpha background, exact 3 columns x 2 rows of equal 512x512 cells. Exactly SIX cats, ONE per cell, row-major animation order. NO dividers, labels, numbers, ground, shadow, floor, scenery, checkerboard paint, or props.
Every cell is a fixed camera, same scale as the 512x512 reference: whole cat approximately x=19..490 and y=65..474. All grounded paw soles touch EXACTLY local y=474 from top in every cell, virtual anchor (256,474). Keep the same foot locations; no root travel, zoom, recentering, crop, or pose-specific scaling. At least 8 pixels fully transparent around every cell border. NO part may cross a cell boundary.
Six frames: (0) relaxed neutral standing, eyes open; (1) tiny inhale, chest expands subtly, paws fixed; (2) same stance, eyelids halfway closed; (3) soft blink, eyes closed, same face and head volume; (4) eyes reopen gently, tiny exhale; (5) returns exactly to frame 0 pose for a seamless loop. Tail only sways a few pixels, do not change its curl or height drastically. Motion subtle enough to loop at four frames per second.
CRITICAL: true RGBA transparency, alpha 0 outside silhouette and alpha 255 throughout the body, with soft alpha only on silhouette edges. No translucent body, glow, detached fur particles or stray islands. All 6 frames must be the SAME recognizable reference cat, rendered at consistent size and perspective.
prompts.jump-start:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production in-place animation sprite sheet for PetScape. Input PNGs are immutable identity/style references, not edit targets. SAME specific blue-grey kitten: fluffy bluish-grey fur, pale cream muzzle/chest/paws, huge amber eyes, pink nose and inner ears, compact body, large head, furry curled tail at LEFT, face toward RIGHT in three-quarter side view; same soft upper-left 2.5D cartoon rendering as reference. No redesign. True transparent RGBA background. Opaque body; soft edge alpha only. No shadows, ground, text, dividers, labels, props, halos, stray particles.
OUTPUT exactly 1024x1024 pixels, exact TWO BY TWO grid of FOUR 512x512 cells, row-major. ONE cat per cell, full body and tail contained inside its own cell with generous transparent separation, no overlap. Same camera/scale/registration in every frame. Cat same size as reference (roughly 470px wide in each 512 cell), virtual foot root at local (256,474). NO baked world trajectory, no moving the camera or zooming. Create FOUR consecutive JUMP PREPARATION poses lasting 0.15s total: 0 neutral planted stance matching reference; 1 bend all legs a little, lower chest; 2 deepest compact anticipation crouch, chest and pelvis lower, paws STILL PLANTED on local y=474; 3 forceful leg extension pushing off while paw tips are still on y=474, forebody stretches upward slightly. Tail responds but never clips. Keep four paw contact locations and sole baseline fixed in all four frames. Clear squash then stretch, not a walk cycle. Keep head/face volume and identity. The following airborne clip will lift the paws; do not draw a jump arc or lifted body translation here.
